So thinking about on the fly HLS installation...

items.author: mareurs
items.body:
## Summary

The Kotlin Language Server (KLS) is built on IntelliJ IDEA's platform. Each KLS instance creates an `idea-system*` temporary directory under `/tmp`. These directories are never cleaned up after the language server shuts down, causing unbounded accumulation across test runs.

## Observed Impact

On a developer machine with `/tmp` mounted as **tmpfs** (RAM-backed — the default on modern Linux systems), repeated test runs accumulated:

```
329 x idea-system*/  = 30 GiB in RAM
/tmp (tmpfs): 36 GiB used total
```

Each KLS instance produces ~52 MB in its `idea-system*` directory. After
items.title: fix(kotlin): KLS leaves stale `idea-system*` temp dirs in /tmp, consuming RAM on tmpfs systems

## Problem

Serena currently does not support the **Nim** programming language. Nim is not listed in the supported languages in `ls_config.py`, and projects that use Nim cannot leverage Serena's symbolic tools (`get_symbols_overview`, `find_symbol`, `replace_content`, `rename_symbol`, etc.) for `.nim` files.

All symbol-level tools return errors like:
```
ValueError - Cannot extract symbols from file src/cli/main.nim. Active languages: ['lean4']
```

## Proposed Solution

Add **Nim** as a supported language using **[nimlsp](https://github.com/PMunch/nimlsp)** as the LSP server backend.
